text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We're finally here... Kokura, Kitakyushu!
I love this city, but... this is our next stop, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What a charming shopping street!
It has such a wonderful nostalgic vibe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "warrior's pilgrimage" event was now at its fourth stop.
This time, we were visiting Fukuoka, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "A-A ramen that'll win over everyone in Kokura...? Seriously...? There's no way I can just do what I've always done..."
choice_data_list: (…? I wonder if something's bothering her?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Nature-chan, are you from around here?
You seem awfully familiar with the area.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, it's not my hometown, you know? It's just that I've raced around here before.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I know all too well.
Just how hard it is to serve ramen here—
and have people truly find it delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, we have no time to dawdle.
Let's head out to scout the competition right away!

text_block_list.name: Nature & Top Road
text_block_list.text: *Slurp. Sluuuurp...* Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nature & Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing~~~!
It was so delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The firm, thin noodles hold the cloudy broth so well—it's amazing!
It's so delicious it woke me right up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All the gamey odor of the bone broth had transformed into pure umami.
With such an intense flavor, I couldn't stop slurping the noodles.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Now that we've enjoyed some supreme ramen,
shall we be off? —To the next shop!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! The tonkotsu ramen here is even creamier!
It's not overly heavy, so I feel like I could keep ordering extra noodles forever!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right! Once we finish our meal, let's head to the next shop!
choice_data_list: Another one already!? W-Wait just a second...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so yummy...!
The soup here is so rich and hearty, and the noodles are a bit thicker.
I love this too~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Do you understand now?
—Fukuoka is the birthplace of tonkotsu ramen.
Its history began in Kurume...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nagahama ramen, the birthplace of the kaedama noodle refill culture. It gave rise to Hakata ramen, which gained nationwide popularity—truly the "authentic origin."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, no matter where you go...
you'll get delicious ramen!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I seeee... So the people of Kokura have quite sophisticated palates, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Exactly!! Doto, that's it, you're so clever! That's why, if we were to serve some half-baked ramen—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I bet people will just say, '...O-Oh, it's tasty,'
out of pity! I won't be able to walk around
Kokura with my head held high anymore!
choice_data_list: *Gulp*... I-I see. So that's why you panicked...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even so, I can't just keep being scared... Knowing how high the hurdle is, I'll give it my all this time too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Let's brace ourselves and focus even more! All to satisfy the people of Kokura!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna do this...!
When I say I will, I will... Just you watch me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Tonkotsu alone... definitely won't be enough.
Oh, right! If I combine it with chicken broth...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, this is just ordinary, isn't it?
I guess that's just so like me, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Mm! Time to break out of my shell!
All right, let's go for the beef bone broth too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Stinky. Way too stinky. The stench is completely killing the flavor. Any bugs within a 3km radius are gonna drop dead. Guaranteed."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really that bad...?
I only tasted it after I got used to the smell, so...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A long time ago, when I visited Sweden with my father,
I was served what is said to be the smelliest canned food in the world.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I remembered that moment. So vividly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What kind of terrible memory did I just make Your Highness relive...?! I'm so sorry! I'll go make some tea right away!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't get me wrong, okay? It had a strong aftertaste,
but it wasn't like it tasted bad!
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nature-chan.
Is Kokura this kind of place to you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Kokura Castle is so amazing~!
The castle keep was magnificent and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The exhibition was wonderful, and apparently the castle
is open at night too. I'd love to visit at night next time!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Your head seems in the clouds.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive me... I was just thinking.
About what Fine-san told me...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nature-chan.
Is Kokura this kind of place to you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I know why I failed.
I was just getting way too rushed and worked up out there."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Kokura is a ramen battleground, so at this rate we're in trouble.
I'm just spinning my wheels on hype alone..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was just trying to give it a punch? Clinging to the
naive thought that if it smelled strong, it'd taste good.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Still, hmm... I really just wanted to make everyone happy, though~. Where did I go wrong...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think that feeling of
'wanting to make the fans happy' is wrong at all!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, if Nature-chan is making a face like that herself……
then surely.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "There might just be a ramen out there that can convey Nature-chan's feelings even better!"
choice_data_list: What do you want to convey to everyone in Kokura?
What is it you want to convey to everyone in Kokura?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...My feelings. What I...
want to say... ......"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...When I went to Kokura before, everyone
in the shopping district was so kind to me."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's not even my hometown, you know?
Yet they told me to do my best, that they're cheering for my races.
They gave me such warm cheers...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Things like that, somehow,
just remind me of my local shopping district back home.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Having someone on your side puts you at ease, right?
Because I was given that feeling..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Maybe this was what I wanted to give all along.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The folks from the shopping district back home.
The folks from the shopping district near the Academy.
And everyone in Kokura...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm only here today because my fans stood by me through thick and thin. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not "hitting" them with overwhelming richness,
but making something that lets them eat and truly relax.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll be right back!
To find the ultimate ramen—!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Oh, big sis!
You came to visit again, yay!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey~. Just got a quick thing to ask.
Hey, are there any ramen spots around here?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I was hoping to borrow the kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, in the first place... to begin with, you know?
I'm not some born, sparkling main character.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why did I make a bowl of ramen that screams,
"I'm the main star! Look at me!"?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That wasn't like me, and it wasn't like Kokura. That's why—yeah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I have to make it! Properly!
My own way of saying thank you... with a nice drink!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, thank you for the food!
*slurp*... *slurp*... *sluuuuurp*... *SLUUUURP*!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Could you please call the chef?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm right in front of you though!!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ It was super delicious,
*this* ramen!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"With every bite—
I remembered walking the streets of Kokura with everyone."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, it reached me! So I know it'll reach them too!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, um.
Glad to hear that, then... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so arrived the day of the ramen event.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on in, come one, come all!
Get your delicious, piping-hot soy sauce ramen right here~!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Soy sauce ramen? In Kokura?
—Well anyway, thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so good! I was expecting a tonkotsu
ramen, but yeah! This is delicious too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, it goes down super smooth, but
this ramen... Huh? These bendy
bamboo shoots are—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I used bamboo shoots harvested around here!
Fufufu. How is it? It's my masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I didn't just include local specialties—I packed in everything I love about Kokura!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Whether you're a hungover guy,
or a lady too tired from work to eat..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to eat something,
so I aimed for a ramen that people could just keep eating up!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Because for me, that place is Kokura.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When times are tough, it's there for you...
It's a gentle, round place without any sharp edges. This place is.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That is why I love it.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: “Nature-chan...!!!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Now then! There are still pleeenty of seconds left! Please eat as much as you like!
choice_data_list: The line is over here! Please form an orderly queue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, this event closed its curtains
as another great success—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
......Waaaaahhh...!
Was I talking way too much just now!!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I got so carried away 'cause it turned out so delicious...
Why did I have to go and blab about things I shouldn't have... Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm glad, yeah... that you could
accept even those embarrassing feelings of mine...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "It really reminds me of home. Whenever I go back, my mom and everyone else are always so kind to me..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. I need to show more appreciation, day in and day out.
Not just to Kokura, but to Mom and everyone else too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
No time like the present, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, hello, Mom?
Nah, it's nothing major, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking of heading home soon to show my face.
That's all.
